text: F6.22b, rerun: a key taken from any English text should read as English wherever the known letters force it, gaps and all.
Every forced letter scored, given the forced letters before it in its run, English against random letters, in bits; K4's best key against the best of each of 200 shuffles; 20 planted English keys.

Planted keys +9.3 to +36.7 bits, all 20 above every shuffle; K4's best -11.8, below zero, though above 195 of 200 shuffles' bests. K4 has more settings to take a best from (21, median 8): F6.22c matches the count.
